Apparently, not having hot flashes during the day (I was sweating all through the night and had insomnia) meant I wasn’t menopausal.
I had severe joint pain and my inflammation levels were sky high.  I was told that we would need to ‘have a chat’  about my lifestyle. I don’t smoke or drink and eat healthily. I had gone from swimming 1km every second day to finding it difficult to get out of a chair!
I changed practice and the GP recognised that I had in her words, almost all symptoms of menopause . I was given HRT and due to the heavy bleeding I was having, I was referred to gynaecology where a scan showed I had several fibroids. Two years later at the age of 44, I am needing a full hysterectomy. So much for the GP saying I was too young to be menopausal.
I dread to think where I would be if I had stuck with this practice. Ladies, please read up on menopause related stuff, advocate for yourselves and see a different GP if you’re not happy. I thought that because the GP was female, I would have been taken seriously. Unfortunately not.",null,[0,237]]]],[null,null,null,null,null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/1806700269107653349/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXUjFFemFEVmtiVGwzVWxWNFNsWklWalJVV0d4MFlVWmFXVkV6WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1806700269107653349/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXUjFFemFEVmtiVGwzVWxWNFNsWklWalJVV0d4MFlVWmFXVkV6WXhBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/1806700269107653349/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXUjFFemFEVmtiVGwzVWxWNFNsWklWalJVV0d4MFlVWmFXVkV6WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1806700269107653349/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXUjFFemFEVmtiVGwzVWxWNFNsWklWalJVV0d4MFlVWmFXVkV6WXhBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/1806700269107653349/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXUjFFemFEVmtiVGwzVWxWNFNsWklWalJVV0d4MFlVWmFXVkV6WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1806700269107653349/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXUjFFemFEVmtiVGwzVWxWNFNsWklWalJVV0d4MFlVWmFXVkV6WXhBQhAA"]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pWR1EzaDVkbTl3UlV4SlZIVjRUWGx0YUZaWVEzYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xd3b3c3fee00d9834!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOjVGQ3h5dm9wRUxJVHV4TXltaFZYQ3c%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pWR1EzaDVkbTl3UlV4SlZIVjRUWGx0YUZaWVEzYxAB&t=1&-w7PTKgswZFRJWHZDTDU5cA&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiuhJy1urCTAxUPUIQGHQ3HCDkQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiuhJy1urCTAxUPUIQGHQ3HCDkQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUZLWXpKZlgxOWZSV2hCV0VOWFRYWnNNVmhFT0ZrNVYwbGtORUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSV1VOWlh6VTJXa3RuV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21SWFVWVjFXVVJOY1dKV1RHNDJiRnBDVlVKMU5sRRAB",["0x0:0xd3b3c3fee00d9834",null,1755683122815170,1755683122815170,[null note that this review was written before covid-19.

I'm fairly new to the practice. The standard of care I have been given has been awesome. The doctors and nurses I have seen so far have been understanding, caring, and knowledgeable and put you at ease when you go in to see them. You may have to wait a bit before seeing somebody, but this is understandable, as some patients take longer than others.
Reception staff I have always found to be very helpful and approachable. Any issues I've had, have been dealt with quickly and efficiently.
Notifications about other services and where to go, are on a big board right by the door as you come in, which is useful.
Tech wise, they are right up there with a self check in, located on the left hand wall by reception. I have also received text messages straight to my mobile phone (which is handy) for general notifications or if the practice need me to contact them back for something.
I would thoroughly recommend The Millig Practice to anyone. They're definitely getting it right in standards of care.",null,[0,138]]]],[null,null,null,null,null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/1806700269107653349/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUnplSE5YYjNaM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1806700269107653349/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUnplSE5YYjNaM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/1806700269107653349/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUnplSE5YYjNaM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1806700269107653349/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUnplSE5YYjNaM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/1806700269107653349/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUnplSE5YYjNaM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1806700269107653349/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUnplSE5YYjNaM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D"]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURzeHNXb3Z3RRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xd3b3c3fee00d9834!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgIDsxsWovwE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURzeHNXb3Z3RRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURzeHNXb3Z3RRIsChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURzeHNXb2Z3EhJDZ3NJLTQ2N2l3WVFzTHJ0Q3caLQoXQ0lITTBvZ0tFSUNBZ0lEc3hzV29fd0USEkNnc0l4YlAwOGdVUW9LT09hZyISCQAAAAAAAAAAETSYDeD-w7PTKhJDZ3NJLTQ2N2l3WVFzTHJ0Q3c&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiuhJy1urCTAxUPUIQGHQ3HCDkQoykIDSgB"],null,[null,[[1,1]]]],"0ahUKEwiuhJy1urCTAxUPUIQGHQ3HCDkQ0pMFCAsoAw"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCQnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURVI2VDI1ZlgxOWZSV2hEZW5wdVRXaFhkVnBTU1RWRVMweGtRVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEl3UlVObk1tUkZlREk0V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMxdWRxOF9BRRAB",["0x0:0xd3b3c3fee00d9834",null,1704105984721241,1704105984721241,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/104926950655940734737/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Anna
